adaptation.descriptionVi: Nội tại tăng độ mạnh làm chậm của Sương Băng. Khi bật, Anivia tạo bão tại vị trí chọn, gây 4 sát thương mỗi 0,5 giây và làm chậm kẻ địch trong 1 giây, liên tục làm mới khi chúng ở trong vùng. Bão lớn dần trong 1,5 giây; khi đạt kích thước tối đa, sát thương tăng 300% thành 12 mỗi nhịp, hiệu lực làm chậm tăng 50%, kéo dài 1,5 giây và làm mới mỗi 0,25 giây. Tắt bão gây một nhịp cuối và nhận toàn bộ hồi chiêu; bão cũng tự tắt khi Anivia chết, thiếu năng lượng, đi quá xa hoặc bị hiệu ứng cấm thi triển.
gameplayNotes: LOL2D thay 15–30 sát thương mỗi nhịp cộng 6,25% SMPT bằng 4 sát thương mỗi 0,5 giây và thay 45–90 cộng 18,75% SMPT khi cường hóa bằng 12; không áp dụng tăng tiến theo cấp hay SMPT.

Giữ nguyên trạng thái bật/tắt đang hoạt động (không phải vận sức), thời gian lớn 1,5 giây, hệ số 300%, nhịp sát thương/làm mới, nhịp cuối, khoảng cách duy trì, năng lượng và điều kiện ngắt từ dữ liệu PC nhập.

description.raw: '''Passive:''' ''[[File:Anivia Flash Frost.png|20xpx|border|link=Anivia#Flash Frost|An icon for Anivia's ability Flash Frost]] [[Anivia#Flash Frost|Flash Frost's]]'' [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] strength is increased.
description.text: Passive: Flash Frost's slow strength is increased.

description2.raw: '''Toggle:''' '''Anivia''' calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail at the target location, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies within and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 1 second, refreshing every 0.5 seconds while they remain inside.
description2.text: Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail at the target location, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies within and slowing them for 1 second, refreshing every 0.5 seconds while they remain inside.

description3.raw: The blizzard increases in size over 1.<small>5</small> seconds. At maximum size, ''Glacial Storm'' is empowered to deal 300% damage and increase the effectiveness of its slow by 50%, which also instead lasts 1.<small>5</small> seconds and refreshes every 0.<small>25</small> seconds.
description3.text: The blizzard increases in size over 1.5 seconds. At maximum size, Glacial Storm is empowered to deal 300% damage and increase the effectiveness of its slow by 50%, which also instead lasts 1.5 seconds and refreshes every 0.25 seconds.

description4.raw: Toggling ''Glacial Storm'' off triggers a final tick of damage and incurs its full cooldown. ''Glacial Storm'' is toggled off automatically if '''Anivia''' moves too far away from the blizzard or becomes unable to pay the [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost, or is affected by any form of [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disrupting|An icon representing the keyword Cast-inhibiting crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disrupting|cast-inhibiting crowd control]].

notes.raw: * Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * ''Glacial Storm's'' slow leaves a trail that is visible even if the target is [[stealth]]ed. * ''Glacial Storm'' deals 3 half ticks at 200 / 267 / 333 radius for a total of 1.5 normal damage ticks before it starts dealing empowered damage at 400 radius. * [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Invulnerability#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis (buff)]] [[:Invulnerability#Stasis|Stasis]] via [[File:Zhonya's Hourglass item.png|20xpx|border|link=Zhonya's Hourglass|An icon for the item Zhonya's Hourglass]] [[Zhonya's Hourglass]] doesn't interrupt ''Glacial Storm''. ** [[File:Tahm Kench OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Tahm Kench|An icon representing Tahm Kench]] [[Tahm Kench|Tahm Kench's]] [[File:Tahm Kench Devour.png|20xpx|border|link=Tahm Kench#Devour|An icon for Tahm Kench's ability Devour]] [[Tahm Kench#Devour|Devour]] '''does''' interrupt (allied and enemy) ''Glacial Storm''.
notes.text:
Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Glacial Storm's slow leaves a trail that is visible even if the target is stealthed.
Glacial Storm deals 3 half ticks at 200 / 267 / 333 radius for a total of 1.5 normal damage ticks before it starts dealing empowered damage at 400 radius.
Stasis via Zhonya's Hourglass doesn't interrupt Glacial Storm.
* Tahm Kench's Devour does interrupt (allied and enemy) Glacial Storm.
